rv.q: Indeed the 2 hour and 40 minutes running time (including interval) vastly outstays its welcome.
It has an interesting story at its heart with the potential to shock and move, but it's bogged down with excess dialogue and can't punch through.
I could appreciate the intensity of what was unfolding without always feeling emotionally connected to it.

cn.t: Mixed reviews for this O'Neill revival — atmospheric lighting and sound earn praise, but the production feels like a tough, slow watch that never fully convinces.
